label: pjm 2022 2021 touchpoints
definition: PJM 2022+2021 VALIDATION TOUCHPOINTS on the CURRENT keeper (rule 22 validation tier; freeze scope = locked_test only since the 2026-08-26 owner ruling). Byte-faithful replay of the 2026-08-15-pjm-162-inputclock keeper recipe (results/calibration/pjm_debugb_inputclock_A/meta.json) through the sanctioned replay_keeper channel. Frozen recipe, zero deltas: no parameter was tuned for, against, or in response to 2021 or 2022. 2022 SUPERSEDES 2026-08-05-pjm-2022-touchpoint, which measured the pjm-152 recipe on the PRE-REPAIR input clock that pjm-162 IS; 2021 is a rung never before solved. PJM 2020 is NOT solved and is NOT data-ready (defective zonal demand feed, no calibration_reference block, no renewable-capacity file - see ASSESSMENT-neiso-pjm-validation-touchpoints-2026-09-05.md 3.2). ITERABLE model-SELECTION evidence, NEVER a certified out-of-sample skill number.

holdout.tierCaveat: Validation tier: ITERABLE model-SELECTION evidence. NOT a certified out-of-sample skill number and never quotable as one. THE RUN COVERS TWO RUNGS AND THEY DIFFER IN SEVERITY — read `perYear`: 2022 fails on two criteria, 2021 on four. The criterion table below is stamped on the RUN (both years), so a criterion marked degraded may be failing on only one of them: C3a and C3c pass on 2022 and fail on 2021. Neither rung is spent — the validation tier is re-runnable by design, which is what makes the rule-22 loop legal. The touch-once locked test (2019 / H1-2026) is NOT spent here and PJM has never been granted it.
holdout.envelopeCaveat: ONE OPEN LIMIT, NOT CLOSED FOR PJM: the keeper's in-sample column was solved at git 457ae04 and these rungs at 46e08e5b, with 29 solve kwargs added in between (each verified in this bundle's calibration_attestation.json to sit at its ScenarioConfig default) and 2 removed. The rule-30 G-DRIFT hunk audit is not dischargeable at this diff size, and the same-HEAD in-sample control that CLOSED this question for NEISO (drift measured INERT at -0.008% on mean price) was NOT solved for PJM — the verdict is per-ISO (rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]) and does not transfer: PJM's recipe arms pjm_measured_interface_limits, pjm_da_virtual_bids and measured_ramp_capability that NEISO never touches. Solving PJM's 2023-2025 control at HEAD is the first recommendation in ASSESSMENT-neiso-pjm-validation-touchpoints-2026-09-05.md section 5. SEPARATELY, the PJM 2021 REPORT line 'EIA-930 net gen 4939.01 TWh' in the solve log is a printed energy-balance diagnostic contaminated by an int32 sentinel (2,147,480,064 MW in three consecutive hours, 2021-10-18 23:00 to 2021-10-19 01:00, in the PJM hourly extract's Demand and Net generation columns). It does NOT touch any scored criterion: load_demand repairs those hours before the solve, and the C1/C2 benchmark reads the per-fuel e930 block, which is sane (gas 311.7 / coal 183.5 / nuclear 273.0 TWh). See the assessment section 3.3.

perYear.2022: NOT-YET — TWO failing criteria: C1 fuel-mix CC_REGULAR +22.26 TWh (share +1.7pp) and C3b price duration/shape NRMSE 0.250. C2, C3a, C3c, C4, C6, C8 all PASS; C5a CO2 +4.8%.
perYear.2021: NOT-YET — THREE failing criteria: C1 fuel-mix (CC_REGULAR +28.72 TWh / +2.9pp, ST_GAS +8.07 TWh / +1.0pp, COAL_BIT -9.45 TWh / -1.4pp), C3a mean LMP +25.7%, and C3b NRMSE 0.355. C2, C4, C6, C8 PASS. C3c (145 model hours vs 23 actual, 6.30x >$200) is an ACCEPTED LEDGERED CAVEAT, not a failure, under rubric v3.6 — C3c is accepted on every holdout year. The C1 signature is the same direction as 2022's — gas over, coal under — on the year with the cheapest delivered gas in the span.

holdout.supersedesNote: THE STALE RUNG'S DIAGNOSIS DOES NOT CLOSE. The prior 2022 touchpoint measured the pjm-152 recipe on the PRE-REPAIR input clock and failed on C1 CC_REGULAR +18.28 TWh and C3b NRMSE 0.206. The keeper has since moved to pjm-162, which IS that input-clock repair — and on the current recipe 2022 still fails the SAME TWO criteria, with CC_REGULAR slightly WORSE (+22.26 TWh) and C3b at 0.250 on the corrected load-weighted basis. The repair did not reach the 2022 out-of-sample miss. The rung stays OPEN and its named object (the DA-virtual layer, +11.12 TWh of net virtual demand cleared in 2022) is not resolved by it.
holdout.basisNote: C3a/C3b here are scored on the RUBRIC v2.4 LOAD-WEIGHTED basis (`rt_lw`/`da_lw`), like the keeper's in-sample column. That basis did NOT exist for PJM 2021/2022 before this session: actual_lmp.json carried `_lw` for PJM 2019, 2020, 2023, 2024 and 2025 and for every year of every other ISO, but not for these two — so the prior 2022 touchpoint scored C3a on the legacy equal-hour mean while the keeper scored on load-weighted. Filled here with `derive_actual_lmp.py --lw-retrofit --isos PJM --years 2021 2022`, which re-parses no raws and only ADDS fields: a record-by-record diff confirms 2 iso-year records gained `_lw` fields and ZERO existing values changed, so no committed keeper number moved. Effect on this run: 2022 C3b 0.204 -> 0.250 and 2021 C3a +30.4% -> +25.7% (rt_lw 38.53 vs legacy rt 37.14; 74.07 vs 68.79). The comparison is now like-for-like on both sides.
